body.p: provides the ability to organize your DITA resources in projects, the same as with other files. Projects help you manage and organize your files and allow you to perform batch operations (such as validations and transformations) over multiple files or to use Main Files support to rename or move DITA resources while updating the references to them. You can also share your project settings and transformation/validation scenarios with other users.
To learn how to create a new project from a template and how add resources and manage it, see .

To help you get more familiar with how to use projects in DITA, there are several DITA project templates available when using the New Project action (available, for example, from the Project menu). Among them:
